## Genotyping pre-imputation pipeline steps {.tabset}

***

Steps 3-10 below were carried out using the [GenotypeQCtoHRC package](https://github.com/CardiffMRCPathfinder/GenotypeQCtoHRC).
See `eqtlgenotypeshg38pretm.qc_report.html` in the `reports/03GENOTYPES-PRE` directory for those metrics; some additional
details for some of those tests are below. The citation for GenotypeQCtoHRC is [Lynham et al. 2023 (DOI:10.1192/bjo.2022.636)](https://www.cambridge.org/core/journals/bjpsych-open/article/dragondata-a-platform-and-protocol-for-integrating-genomic-and-phenotypic-data-across-large-psychiatric-cohorts/2531261CD4300FCF01FA33C6B8693375).

***

```{r setup, include=FALSE, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(cowplot)
library(DT)
library(glue)
library(gt)

# Set variables from params (paths are relative to workflow/)
het_file <- params$het
sexcheck_file <- params$sexcheck
kinship_file <- params$kinship
ancestry_file <- params$ancestry
dup_samples_file <- params$dup_samples
ambig_snp_lst <- params$ambig_snp_lst
rare_snps_log <- params$rare_snps_log
qc2hrc_counts_file <- params$qc2hrc_counts
final_counts_file <- params$final_counts
bmark_dir <- params$bmark_dir
```

Rules:

1. `convert_raw`: Convert raw genotypes to plink format
2. `add_sex_to_fam`: Set FID = IID and add sex annotations to the fam file
3. `rm_dup_sample`: Remove duplicate sample
4. `check_het`: LD-prune (`--indep-pairwise 50 5 0.2`) and check autosomal heterozygosity
5. `make_kgp3_pgen`: Create the 1000G Phase 3 pgen used for ancestry inference
6. `genotype_qc2hrc`: Run GenotypeQCtoHRC to prep genotypes for imputation
7. `cat_genotypes`: Cat chr specific genotypes into a single file
8. `rm_maf_ambig`: Remove strand ambiguous SNPs with MAF > 0.4
9. `rm_rare_snps`: Remove rare SNPs with MAF < 0.01
10. `split_chrs`: Split chrs for TOPMed imputation
11. `gather_stats`: Count SNPs per chr after GenotypeQCtoHRC and in the final VCFs
12. `geno_pre_report`: Generate this report

QC steps:

1. Rm duplicate sample (14493 and 144FC same sample. 14493 removed)
2. Check autosomal heterozygosity
3. Missingness:
  - Sample rm if > 5% markers missing,
  - SNPs excluded if missing in > 5% samples
4. HWE p < 1 x 10-6
5. Samples ambig. sex assignments removed (all passed)
6. Relatedness assessed (duplicate sample identified 14493 and removed)
7. Ancestry assessed
8. Liftover hg19 to hg38
9. Conversion of markers to dbSNP 156 using 1000G Phase 3
10. [Genotype Harmonizer](https://github.com/molgenis/systemsgenetics/wiki/Genotype-Harmonizer) used to align curated markers to the Trans-Omics for Precision Medicine ([TopMED](https://topmed.nhlbi.nih.gov/)) imputation panel; all ambiguous A/T, G/C SNPs removed (`--ambiguousSnpFilter`)
11. Remove ambiguous A/T, G/C SNP with MAF > 0.4 (a check that none remain after step 10)
12. Remove SNPs MAF < 0.01

***

Settings:

```{r settings, echo = FALSE}
tibble(
  Setting = c("Duplicate sample(s) removed (FID IID)"),
  Value   = c(paste(readLines(dup_samples_file), collapse = "; "))
) |>
  knitr::kable()
```

***

### QC 2: Autosomal Heterozygosity {.tabset}

***

#### Tables

```{r, autosomal_het_table, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
het_tbl <- read.table(het_file, header = T) |>
  tibble() |>
  rename(O_HOM = 'O.HOM.', E_HOM = 'E.HOM.', N_NM = 'N.NM.') |>
  mutate(het_rate = (N_NM - O_HOM) / N_NM) |>
  # ID outliers based on het rate
  mutate(
    mean_het = mean(het_rate),
    sd_het = sd(het_rate),
    outlier_het = abs(het_rate - mean_het) > 4 * sd_het
  ) |>
  # ID outliers based on inbreeding coefficient F
    mutate(
    mean_F = mean(F),
    sd_F = sd(F),
    outlier_F = abs(F - mean_F) > 4 * sd_F | F < -0.15 | F > 0.15
  ) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)))
datatable(het_tbl, caption = 'Table 1. Autosomal heterozygosity table')
```

***

```{r, het_outliers, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
outliers_tbl <- het_tbl %>%
  filter(outlier_het | outlier_F) %>%
  select(FID, IID, outlier_het, outlier_F)
datatable(outliers_tbl, caption = 'Table 2. Autosomal heterozygosity outliers table')
```

***

#### Plot

***

```{r, het_plot, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim=c(10, 5)}
het_plot <- ggplot(het_tbl, aes(x = het_rate)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.005, fill = "#4C78A8", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean_het + 4 * sd_het), color = "#E31A1C", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean_het - 4 * sd_het), color = "#E31A1C", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Heterozygosity Rate Distribution",
    x = "Heterozygosity Rate",
    y = "Count",
    caption = "Red dashed lines indicate ±4 SD thresholds"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0)
  )

# Create publication-ready F distribution plot
f_plot <- ggplot(het_tbl, aes(x = F)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.01, fill = "#F28E2B", color = "black", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean_F + 4 * sd_F), color = "#E31A1C", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean_F - 4 * sd_F), color = "#E31A1C", linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-0.15, 0.15), color = "#E31A1C", linetype = "solid", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Inbreeding Coefficient (F) Distribution",
    x = "Inbreeding Coefficient (F)",
    y = "Count",
    caption = "Red lines: solid = [-0.15, 0.15], dashed = ±4 SD"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "black"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0)
  )

combined_plot <- plot_grid(het_plot, f_plot, labels = c("A", "B"),
                           label_size = 14, label_fontface = "bold",
                           ncol = 2, align = "h")
combined_plot
```

### QC 5: Sex ambiguity

***

```{r sex_summary, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
sex_tbl <- read.table(
  file = sexcheck_file,
  header = FALSE,
  skip = 1,        # Skip the header row
  col.names = c("FID", "IID", "PEDSEX", "SNPSEX", "STATUS", "F", "YCOUNT"),
  colClasses = c("character", "character", "integer", "integer", "character", "numeric", "integer"),
  sep = ""  # Let read.table auto-detect whitespace (spaces or tabs)
) %>%
  as_tibble()

datatable(sex_tbl, caption = 'Table 3. Sex ambiguities')
```

### QC 11-12: Post-GenotypeQCtoHRC checks

***

+ `r glue("{length(readLines(ambig_snp_lst))} ambiguous SNPs with MAF > 0.4 removed")`
+ `r glue("{grep('removed', readLines(rare_snps_log), value = TRUE)} SNPs with MAF < 0.01 removed")`


***

```{r, snp counts, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
pre_snp_cnts_tbl <- read_tsv(qc2hrc_counts_file, col_names = c('chr', 'gQCtoHRC_cnts'))
post_snp_cnts_tbl <- read_tsv(final_counts_file, col_names = c('chr', 'final_cnts'))
final_snp_cnt_tbl <- pre_snp_cnts_tbl |>
  left_join(post_snp_cnts_tbl)
datatable(final_snp_cnt_tbl, caption = 'Table 7. SNP counts after GenotypeQCtoHRC and post-SNP checks')
```

### Benchmarking {.tabset}

***

#### Table

```{r benchmarking, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# Benchmark files: reports/benchmarks/03genotypes_pre_impute.<rule>[_<wildcards>].benchmark.txt
# Files are matched against the current rules, so benchmarks of removed rules drop out
smk_rules <- c("convert_raw", "add_sex_to_fam", "rm_dup_sample", "check_het",
               "make_kgp3_pgen", "genotype_qc2hrc", "cat_genotypes", "rm_maf_ambig",
               "rm_rare_snps", "split_chrs", "gather_stats", "geno_pre_report")
valid_wildcards <- ""

files <- list.files(bmark_dir, pattern = "^03genotypes_pre_impute\\..*\\.benchmark\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)

benchmarks <- map_dfr(files, function(f) {
  stem <- str_remove(basename(f), "^03genotypes_pre_impute\\.") |> str_remove("\\.benchmark\\.txt$")
  rule <- smk_rules[stem == smk_rules | startsWith(stem, paste0(smk_rules, "_"))][1]
  if (is.na(rule)) return(NULL)
  wildcards <- str_remove(stem, paste0("^", rule, "_?"))
  if (!wildcards %in% valid_wildcards) return(NULL)
  df <- read.table(f, header = TRUE, sep = "\t")

  tibble(
    file = f,
    rule = rule,
    runtime_sec = df$s,
    runtime_hms = df$h.m.s.,
    max_rss = df$max_rss
  )
})

# Summarise by rule
summary <- benchmarks %>%
  group_by(rule) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    mean_runtime_min = mean(runtime_sec) / 60,
    sd_runtime_min = sd(runtime_sec) / 60,
    mean_ram_gb = mean(max_rss) / 1024,
    sd_ram_gb = sd(max_rss) / 1024,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    sd_runtime_min = if_else(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min),
    sd_ram_gb = if_else(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)
  ) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  arrange(rule)

# Table
summary %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(
    title = "Table 8. Benchmarking",
    subtitle = "Means and SD across replicates"
  ) %>%
  cols_label(
    rule = "Rule",
    n = "N",
    mean_runtime_min = "Mean Runtime (min)",
    sd_runtime_min = "SD Runtime (min)",
    mean_ram_gb = "Mean RAM (GB)",
    sd_ram_gb = "SD RAM (GB)"
  ) %>%
  fmt_number(
    columns = c(mean_runtime_min, sd_runtime_min, mean_ram_gb, sd_ram_gb),
    decimals = 2
  ) %>%
  tab_options(
    table.font.size = px(14),
    table.border.top.style = "none",
    table.border.bottom.style = "solid",
    table.border.bottom.width = px(2),
    table.border.bottom.color = "black",
    heading.align = "center"
  ) %>%
  tab_style(
    style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
    locations = cells_column_labels(everything())
  )
```

***

#### Plot

***

```{r, runtime_plt, echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.dim=c(10, 5)}
runtime_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_runtime_min),
                                 y = mean_runtime_min)) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_runtime_min - ifelse(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min), 0),
                    ymax = mean_runtime_min + ifelse(is.na(sd_runtime_min), 0, sd_runtime_min)),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "Runtime (minutes)",
       title = "Mean runtime per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

mem_plt <- ggplot(summary, aes(x = reorder(rule, mean_ram_gb),
                                y = mean_ram_gb)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = pmax(mean_ram_gb - ifelse(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb), 0),
                    ymax = mean_ram_gb + ifelse(is.na(sd_ram_gb), 0, sd_ram_gb)),
                width = 0.3, colour = "black", linewidth = 0.6) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "Rule", y = "RAM (GB)",
       title = "Mean RAM usage per rule") +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 18),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

plot_grid(runtime_plt, mem_plt)
```
